raw_text: Tensions escalated in Nagaland on Thursday following reports of a potential breakdown in the NSCN-IM ceasefire agreement. Tribal organizations called for a total shutdown across Dimapur, Kohima, Mon, and Tuensang districts. Road blockades were set up on NH-29 and NH-36. The Morung Express has confirmed that protest coordination was carried out through encrypted Telegram channels and Facebook community groups hours before mainstream coverage.
clean_text: Nagaland tensions escalated over NSCN-IM ceasefire breakdown. Total shutdown across multiple districts with road blockades on NH-29 and NH-36. Coordination via encrypted Telegram preceded mainstream coverage.
